name: Track the Human Optic RAdiation (THORA) - Trekker (V2)
summary: This app uses [Trekker](https://dmritrekker.github.io) to Track the Human Optic Radiation.

parameters.description:
Enter the names of the lgn ROIs that can be found in the rois input datatype. For example, if tracking both the left and right hemisphere ORs, and the lgn roi names are lh.lgn and rh.lgn, enter "lh.lgn rh.lgn". Please see roi datatype for exact name of each.

Note: if ROI name includes "ROI" prefix, do not need to include that in the ROI name

Enter the names of the v2 ROIs that can be found in the rois input datatype. For example, if tracking both the left and right hemisphere ORs, and the v2 roi names are lh.v2 and rh.v2, enter "lh.v2 rh.v2". Please see roi datatype for exact name of each.

Note: if ROI name includes "ROI" prefix, do not need to include that in the ROI name

Enter the names of the exclusion ROIs that can be found in the rois input datatype. For example, if tracking both the left and right hemisphere ORs, and the lgn roi names are lh.exclusion and rh.exclusion, enter "lh.exclusion rh.exclusion". Please see roi datatype for exact name of each. Note: if ROI name includes "ROI" prefix, do not need to include that in the ROI name

These exclusion can be any grouping of ROIs that you DO NOT want streamlines to cross. For example, opposite hemisphere white matter, cerebellar white matter, hippocampus are good exclusions for the OR. 

If you do not want to use exclusion ROIs, leave blank
minimum radius of curvature. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best curvature. Otherwise, enter value of radius of curvature (i.e 0.5)
step size. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best step size. Otherwise, enter value of step size (i.e 0.5)
if want to run on only one lmax, set to true. to ensemble, set to false
minimum FOD amplitude. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best FOD amplitude. Otherwise, enter value of FOD amplitude (i.e 0.5)
max sampling per seed. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best number of max sampling per seed. Otherwise, enter value here (100000)
max trials. If left as 'default', trekker will automatically determine best number of max trials. Otherwise, enter value here (100000)
